name: memory_search
description: Find stored memories by meaning (vector similarity), not by literal text — finds "JWT auth pattern" when you query "token-based login flow". Use when native Grep is wrong because Grep matches characters and you need to find conceptually-related entries across past sessions. Backed by HNSW index over ONNX embeddings; returns top-k with similarity scores. Pair with smart=true for query expansion + MMR diversity.

namespace.description: Namespace to search (default: all namespaces — omit to search across every namespace)

provenance_filter.description: ADR-323: restrict results to these provenance types (e.g. exclude user_claim when fact-checking). Omit for no filtering. Enforced for standard and SmartRetrieval searches.

smart.description: Enable SmartRetrieval pipeline — query expansion, RRF fusion, recency boost, MMR diversity (default: false)
